protocol: Abstract logical play only; no browser or UI
playerModel: Inherited root model configuration; exact model identifier not exposed by collaboration metadata. Models were not independently varied.
isolation: Instruction-based. Players were restricted to logical-play.ts for play, with an explicit exception to write only their own reports. They reported no source, saved-run, solver or other-player access.
previewExposure: Initial logical-cli-1 captures did not record preview calls. Progression player reports one; other players report none. This is self-report, not independently measured telemetry. logical-cli-2 records future preview calls without changing existing model replay hashes.
limits: One player per candidate family; repeated sessions retain experience. Progression uses both a new observation condition and persistence, so differences from relations2 do not isolate either factor. Zero new human playtests. No validated prediction of human enjoyment.
